notes.title: "Part I 1.1.1" Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Part I 1.1.1 is now available on Steam![/h3]


In this update, we fixed some minor bugs and graphical details that could adversely affect the gameplay experience.

[b]In addition, from now on, macOS users will be able to download and play the game (without installing additional programs that open Windows .exe files).[/b]

[u]If you have any problems with opening the application on macOS, please report it to [i]casen.help@gmail.com[/i].[/u]

notes.title: Version "Part I 1.1" Update!
